<% const tick = ''; const c = campaign; /* Shared client testimonials; wording and existing order are preserved. */ const reviews = testimonials.reviews; const excerptSegments = (text, phrases) => { const ranges = phrases.map(phrase => ({ start: text.indexOf(phrase), text: phrase })) .filter(range => range.start >= 0).sort((a, b) => a.start - b.start); const segments = []; let position = 0; ranges.forEach(range => { if (range.start < position) return; segments.push({ text: text.slice(position, range.start), highlighted: false }); segments.push({ text: range.text, highlighted: true }); position = range.start + range.text.length; }); segments.push({ text: text.slice(position), highlighted: false }); return segments; }; // Splits the attribution into display lines; the lines concatenate back to the exact original. const attributionLines = (attribution) => { const nameEnd = attribution.indexOf(','); const paren = attribution.indexOf(' ('); const special = paren > -1; const roleEnd = special ? paren : attribution.indexOf(',', nameEnd + 1); const lastComma = attribution.lastIndexOf(','); const locationStart = lastComma > roleEnd ? lastComma + 1 : attribution.length; const roleStop = roleEnd + (special ? 0 : 1); return { name: attribution.slice(0, nameEnd + 1), role: attribution.slice(nameEnd + 1, roleStop), business: attribution.slice(roleStop, locationStart), location: attribution.slice(locationStart) }; }; %>
